PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Kevin Scott, President  Gina Maguire, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Vice President  Al Austin II, Commissioner
Charles Parkin, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

  REVISED

  Members of the public have the option to email comments to commission@lbutilities.org

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

ELECTION OF OFFICERS – PRESIDENT, VICE PRESIDENT, SECRETARY

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  26-56138  Recommendation to approve August 6, 2026 (Board meeting) and August 27,
  2026 (Special meeting and Prop 218 Public Hearing) meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56139  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for September 17, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-56141  Recommendation to adopt the Request for Proposals (RFP) for Dry Inspection
  Services for Out-of-Service Potable Water Tanks and award a contract to HDR
  Engineering, Inc., of Omaha, Nebraska, in an amount not to exceed $346,755.70
  for a period of two years, and authorize the General Manager to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any necessary
  amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-56142  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Contract No. 32301105 with Quality Fence Co., Inc., of
  Paramount, California, for furnishing, delivery, and installation of permanent and
  temporary fencing on an as-needed basis, to increase the annual contract amount
  by $300,000, for a revised annual contract amount not to exceed $600,000.

  Page 1 of 6
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

REGULAR AGENDA

5.  26-56140  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend Contract No. UT-3919 with Southland Industries, of Garden
  Grove, California, for heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC)
  maintenance services, to increase the annual contract amount by $300,000, for a
  revised annual contract amount not to exceed $609,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  26-56143  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-08-26 and award a contract to Lucas
  Builders, Inc., of La Habra, California, for the Rehabilitation of Sewer Lift Stations
  S-19, S-28, and S-29 Project (SC-0510), in a total amount not to exceed
  $4,364,288.00; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  26-56144  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) to provide Construction
  Management and Inspection Services for the Rehabilitation of Sewer Lift Stations
  S-19, S-28, and S-29 Project (SC-0510), and award a contract to Accenture
  Infrastructure and Capital Projects, LLC, of Chicago, Illinois, in a total amount not
  to exceed $831,485.00, for a period of three years; and authorize the General
  Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into the contract, including
  any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  26-56145  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) for Engineering Services
  for the Groundwater Resilience Program (GRP) Feasibility Study Project (EO-
  3791), and award a contract to Jacobs Engineering Group, Inc., of Dallas, Texas,
  in a total amount not to exceed $938,294.00 for a period of two years; and
  authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to enter into
  the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

9.  26-56146  Recommendation to grant the request of US Builders and Consultants, Inc.,
  pursuant to Public Contract Code Section 5101, to be relieved of their bid as set
  forth in their letter dated September 4, 2026, requesting withdrawal of their bid due
  to clerical errors.

  Page 2 of 6
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-07-26 and award a contract to Mike
  Prlich and Sons, Inc., of Baldwin Park, California, for the Rancho Los Alamitos
  Transmission Main Abandonment Project (MC-5264), in a total amount not to
  exceed $1,167,700.00; and authorize the General Manager to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 26-56147  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) to provide Construction
  Management Services for the Rancho Los Alamitos Transmission Main
  Abandonment Project (MC-5264), and award a contract to Lee and Ro, Inc., of City
  of Industry, California, in a total amount not to exceed $164,364.00, for a period of
  one year; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary
  to enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

11. 26-56148  Recommendation to adopt Specifications WD-56-22 and award a contract to
  Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc., of Pico Rivera, California, for the Alley
  Water Main Conversion Pacific Avenue Project (MC-5198), in a total amount not to
  exceed $7,663,260; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

12. 26-56149  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) to provide Construction
  Management and Inspection Services for the Alley Water Main Conversion Pacific
  Avenue Project (MC-5198), and award a contract to Lee & Ro, Inc., of City of
  Industry, California, in a total amount not to exceed $556,622, for a period of two
  years; and authorize the General Manager to execute all documents necessary to
  enter into the contract, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

13. 26-56150  Recommendation to adopt Request for Proposal (RFP) for On-Call Professional
  Engineering Services and award contracts to JIG Consultants, of Orange,
  California; DRP Engineering, Inc., of Monterey Park, California; Kyle Groundwater,
  Inc., of Pomona, California; GHD, Inc., of Irvine, California; Black & Veatch, of
  Lafayette, California; Lee & Ro, Inc., of City of Industry, California; AKM Consulting
  Engineers, of Irvine, California; Tetra Tech, Inc., of Pasadena, California; Dudek, of
  Encinitas, California; Stantec Consulting Services, Inc., of Denver, Colorado;
  Cannon Corporation, of San Luis Obispo, California; Michael Baker International,
  Inc., of Moon Township, Pennsylvania; Environ Architecture, Inc., of Long Beach,
  California; AtkinsRealis USA Inc., of Tampa, Florida; Energy Experts International,
  of Redwood City, California; Wood Rodgers, Inc., of Sacramento, California;

  Page 3 of 6
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2026
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Corrpro Companies, Inc., of Houston, Texas; Farwest Corrosion Control Company,
  of Downey, California; Harper & Associates Engineering, Inc., of Corona,
  California; NUVIS, of Newport Beach, California; SA Associates, of Arcadia,
  California; Pacific Advanced Civil Engineering, Inc., of Fountain Valley, California;
  Diversified Project Services International, Inc., of Bakersfield, California; SPEC
  Services, Inc., of Fountain Valley, California; and KPFF Consulting Engineers, of
  Watsonville, California; in a total aggregate amount not to exceed $12,000,000, for
  a period of three years, with the option to renew for one additional year, at the
  discretion of the General Manager; and authorize the General Manager to execute
  all documents necessary to enter into the contracts, including any amendments.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

14. 26-56151  Recommendation to adopt Resolution No. UT-1569 authorizing the General
  Manager to execute a contract, and any necessary documents, including any
  amendments, with Ocean Blue Environmental Services, Inc., of Long Beach,
  California (“Ocean Blue”), for providing as needed hazardous waste removal
  services on the same terms and conditions afforded to the City of Pasadena,
  California (Contract No. 33739), except as modified by mutual agreement of the
  Board and Ocean Blue, in an annual amount not to exceed $1,000,000, until the
  City of Pasadena contract expires on July 28, 2031, with an option to renew for as
  long as the City of Pasadena contract remains in effect, at the discretion of the
  General Manager.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

15. 26-56152  Recommendation to receive and file the 2026 Long Beach Public Utilities
  Department Water Resources Plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

16. 26-56153  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute an Agreement and
  all necessary documents, including any amendments, with the City of Signal Hill for
  the delivery of groundwater pumped by the Long Beach Public Utilities Department
  to the City of Signal Hill.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

17. 26-56154  Recommendation to receive and file August 6, 2026 Infrastructure Committee
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ADJOURNMENT

hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans

of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626

At 9:00 AM, President Scott called the meeting to order.

A motion was made by President Scott to nominate Vice President Cordero as President of the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners. Motion carried unanimously.

A motion was made by Vice President Cordero to nominate Secretary Parkin as Vice President of the
Board of Public Utilities Commissioners. Motion carried unanimously.

A motion was made by Secretary Parkin to nominate Commissioner Austin as Secretary of the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners. Motion carried unanimously.

serving their new roles at the October 1st Board meeting.
